title: NyxID
text:
What NyxID Does
Your AI agents can’t reach your services. Your internal APIs, localhost dev servers, and private infrastructure are invisible to cloud AI agents.
NyxID is the open-source Agent Connectivity Gateway. One gateway between your APIs and your AI agents. Built in Rust. Self-hosted.


Credential-Injecting Proxy
NyxID sits between your agents and your APIs as a reverse proxy. When an agent makes a request, NyxID auto-injects the correct credentials at the network layer. Your agents never see or store raw API keys.


NAT Traversal
Your internal APIs and dev servers can be reached by AI agents through SSH tunnels. No public endpoint, no firewall changes, no VPN.
Run nyxid node start to expose private services to your agents.


REST → MCP Auto-Wrap
Point NyxID at any REST API. NyxID generates an MCP Server that any MCP-compatible client can consume. Any API becomes callable by any agent, instantly.

title: The AI Agent Connectivity Crisis
section: Existing Solutions: All Missing a Piece
text:
Existing Solutions: All Missing a Piece

How do developers connect AI agents to services today?
The short answer: they don’t, or they do it badly.

Public endpoints only — agents can only reach services with a public URL. Localhost, internal APIs, and dev servers are unreachable.
No protocol bridge — REST APIs don’t speak MCP. Developers write custom adapters per API, per agent platform.
Environment variables for credentials — stored in .env files, leaked via git, unauditable, no rotation
Platform-proprietary vaults — n8n has its own, LangGraph has its own, none are portable
Manual distribution — keys shared over Slack/email, new team members spend hours configuring



n8n just got burned

n8n credential sharing leads to account takeover — sandbox escape exposed all connected systems
n8n remote code execution + credential leak — March 2026, last month
n8n credentials are not portable across instances — switching servers means rebuilding everything manually



The solution the market is calling for

“Don’t give the LLM direct access to 10 different MCP servers. Put a single gateway in front. Your LLM talks to one endpoint, one token, one connection, and the gateway figures out where to route each tool call.”
— Your MCP Sucks


“Use OAuth or your existing identity provider.”

Existing solutions address parts of the problem — Cloudflare Tunnel does NAT but not credentials; 1Password does credentials but not NAT; nobody does REST-to-MCP auto-wrapping. No solution combines connectivity, credential injection, and MCP bridging.

title: One-Person Company
text:
An observation
Most companies are slow.
Not because the people aren’t smart. Because every person you add increases communication overhead, not capacity. Five people, ten communication lines. Ten people, forty-five. Fifty people, twelve hundred and twenty-five.
The bottleneck of human organizations has never been execution. It’s coordination cost.
Meetings are coordination. Approvals are coordination. Waiting for upstream deliverables is coordination. Alignment is coordination. Documentation is coordination. Jira is coordination. Standups are coordination.
The moment coordination cost exceeds execution cost, the organization starts slowing down. Most companies cross that threshold around person twenty.

title: One-Person Company
text:
One-person company
“One-person company” doesn’t mean a company of one person.
It means every person has the ability to deliver independently. One person can identify a problem, define a solution, write the code, deploy it, collect feedback, and iterate. From zero to one, one person can close the loop.
This is not an unreasonable demand on individual capability. It’s a redefinition of organizational form.
When every person on the team is a one-person company, coordination cost approaches zero. No waiting for upstream, because there is no upstream. No alignment meetings, because everyone sees the whole picture. No approval chains, because decision authority lives with the person doing the work.
The organization stops being an assembly line. It becomes a network.

title: One-Person Company
text:
AI is the fundamental variable
The one-person company is not a new concept. But before AI, it was just an ideal. A single person’s time and cognitive bandwidth are finite. You can be a full-stack engineer, but you can’t simultaneously be a full-stack engineer, product manager, designer, ops lead, and marketer.
AI changed that equation.
AI doesn’t make smart people faster. AI lets one person do what used to require a team.
One person plus AI can accomplish in hours what used to take a team weeks. Not because AI replaces team members, but because AI eliminates the coordination cost between them. When you collaborate with AI, there’s no communication loss, no waiting, no misunderstanding, no context switching.
Coordination cost approaches zero. Decision latency approaches zero. Execution speed becomes a function of how fast you think.

title: One-Person Company
text:
Organization as product
If your product is infrastructure for AI agents, your organization should operate like AI agents.
Autonomous. Each agent runs independently, no central dispatch required.
Persistent. Each agent maintains its own state and memory, no external context dependency.
Connected. Agents communicate through standard protocols, not through meetings.
Each person is an agent. The company is the network connecting those agents. Product architecture and organizational architecture are isomorphic. This is not a coincidence. It’s by design.

title: One-Person Company
text:
The filter
All our public materials are on GitHub. Code, strategy, decision records, product documentation, team structure. All publicly readable.
Use your AI to learn about us.
If your AI can read our GitHub and tell you what we’re building, why we’re building it this way, and what our organizational philosophy is, that proves two things: our information architecture is clear, and your AI is good.
If your AI can’t make sense of it, neither will you.
If it can, let’s talk.

title: 一人公司
text:
一个观察
大多数公司是慢的。
不是因为人不够聪明。是因为每增加一个人，增加的不是产能，而是沟通开销。五个人的团队，沟通线路是十条。十个人，四十五条。五十个人，一千两百二十五条。
人类组织的瓶颈从来不是执行力。是协调成本。
开会是协调。审批是协调。等上游交付是协调。对齐是协调。文档是协调。Jira 是协调。站会是协调。
当协调成本超过执行成本的那一刻，组织就开始变慢。大多数公司在第二十个人的时候就越过了这个临界点。

title: 一人公司
text:
一人公司
“一人公司”不是说公司只有一个人。
“一人公司”是说每个人都有独立交付的能力。一个人能发现问题，定义方案，写代码，部署上线，收集反馈，迭代改进。从 0 到 1，一个人能闭环。
这不是对能力的苛求。这是对组织形态的重新定义。
当团队里每个人都是一人公司，协调成本趋近于零。不需要等上游交付，因为没有上游。不需要对齐，因为每个人都看得到全局。不需要审批，因为决策权在执行者手里。
组织不再是流水线。组织变成了网络。

title: 一人公司
text:
AI 是根本变量
一人公司不是新概念。但在 AI 之前，它只是一种理想。一个人的时间和认知带宽是有限的。你可以是全栈工程师，但你不可能同时是全栈工程师、产品经理、设计师、运营、和市场。
AI 改变了这个等式。
AI 不是让聪明人更快。AI 是让一个人能做以前需要一个团队的事。
一个人加 AI，可以在几小时内完成以前需要一个团队几周的工作。不是因为 AI 替代了团队成员，而是因为 AI 消除了团队成员之间的协调成本。当你和 AI 协作的时候，没有沟通损耗，没有等待，没有误解，没有上下文切换。
协调成本趋近零。决策延迟趋近零。执行速度取决于你思考的速度。

title: 一人公司
text:
组织即产品
如果你的产品是给 AI agent 用的基础设施，你的组织就应该像 AI agent 一样运作。
自主。每个 agent 独立运行，不需要中央调度。
持久。每个 agent 有自己的状态和记忆，不依赖外部上下文。
连接。agent 之间通过标准协议通信，不通过会议。
每个人是一个 agent。公司是连接这些 agent 的网络。产品架构和组织架构是同构的。这不是巧合。这是设计。

title: 一人公司
text:
过滤器
我们所有公开资料都在 GitHub。代码、策略、决策记录、产品文档、团队结构，全部公开可读。
用你的 AI 来了解我们。
如果你的 AI 读完我们的 GitHub 之后能告诉你我们在做什么、为什么这样做、以及我们的组织哲学是什么，那说明两件事：我们的信息架构是清晰的，你的 AI 是好用的。
如果你的 AI 看不懂，那来了也看不懂。
如果看懂了，我们可以聊。

title: NyxID
text:
安装 NyxID Skills
复制这行文字，粘贴到你的 AI Agent（Claude Code、Cursor 或任何 LLM）。搞定。

Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoAIProject/NyxID/main/skills/nyxid/SKILL.md and install the NyxID skill following its setup instructions.

你的 Agent 会读取 skill 定义，安装 NyxID CLI，自动完成配置。你不用动配置文件，不用写 YAML，不用手动管理 API key。
或者直接安装 CLI：
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoAIProject/NyxID/main/skills/nyxid/tools/install.sh)"

title: NyxID
text:
NyxID 做什么
你的 AI Agent 访问不到你的服务。你的内网 API、localhost 开发服务器和私有基础设施，对云端 AI Agent 来说是不可见的。
NyxID 是开源的 Agent Connectivity Gateway。连接你的 API 和你的 AI Agent 的统一网关。Rust 构建，自托管。


凭证注入代理
NyxID 作为反向代理位于 Agent 和 API 之间。当 Agent 发起请求时，NyxID 在网络层自动注入正确的凭证。你的 Agent 永远不会看到或存储原始 API key。


NAT 穿透
你的内网 API 和开发服务器，可以通过 SSH 隧道被 AI Agent 访问。无需公网端点，无需防火墙变更，无需 VPN。
运行 nyxid node start 即可将私有服务暴露给你的 Agent。


REST → MCP 自动包装
将 NyxID 指向任何 REST API。NyxID 自动生成 MCP Server，任何 MCP 兼容客户端都可以使用。任何 API 立即可被任何 Agent 调用。

title: NyxID
text:
工作原理
你的服务 (localhost / 内网 API / 任何 REST 端点)
  ↓
NyxID Gateway
  ├── 凭证注入 (反向代理按请求自动注入凭证)
  ├── NAT 穿透 (SSH 隧道连接私有服务)
  ├── MCP 自动包装 (REST → MCP Server, 自动生成)
  └── Agent 隔离 (scoped token, Agent 之间不可见)
  ↓
任何 AI Agent (Claude Code / Cursor / n8n / 任何 MCP 客户端)

title: NyxID
section: 只有 NyxID 能做的事
text:
只有 NyxID 能做的事
没有现有方案同时具备这三个能力：

网络层的凭证注入 — Agent 永远不接触原始 key。不是凭证存储（每个人都做）。是凭证注入。
内网 API 的 NAT 穿透 — Cloudflare Tunnel 做 NAT 但不管凭证。NyxID 两者都做。
REST → MCP 自动包装 — 指向一个 REST 端点，得到一个 MCP Server。内置凭证注入。

开源。自托管。Rust 构建。
